quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Between a safety zone and the adjacent curb or within 30 feet of points on the curb immediately opposite the ends of a safety zone.

activation.condition: A vehicle stops, stands or parks between a safety zone and the adjacent curb or within 30 feet of either opposite curb-end point.

numeric_conditions.variable: footprint distance to either opposite curb-end point
numeric_conditions.source_clause: within 30 feet of points on the curb immediately opposite the ends of a safety zone

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park in the specified safety-zone area unless a source exception applies.

exceptions.trigger: Necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
exceptions.effect: Exception when necessity is established from original traffic evidence.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original traffic evidence for independent review.
exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic

exceptions.effect: Exception when another law actually governs the activity.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain source authority for independent review.

exceptions.effect: Exception when an actual police direction applies.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original officer direction evidence for review.
exceptions.source_clause: the directions of a police officer

exceptions.effect: Exception when an official device direction applies.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain original device authority and indication evidence for review.

timing.description: Observe the complete stop, stand or park interval and source context.
